title: UPI Global Milestone (1.48M Transactions) & NPCI ‘FiMI’ AI LLM

items: **Cross-Border Volume Surge:** UPI global cross-border transaction volume crossed **1.48 Million transactions** in FY26 (doubling from 0.75 Million in FY25), operational across 8 international countries.

**NPCI ‘FiMI’ LLM Launch:** National Payments Corporation of India launched **FiMI**, a specialized payments-domain Large Language Model developed for conversational digital payments, during the India AI Impact Summit.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → NPCI’s AI model for payments is named ‘FiMI’; UPI cross-border transactions reached 1.48 Million.
